projects.title: GreenGrass
projects.description: A green event platform for VNU-HCM students, with JWT refresh-token rotation, role-based access and a check-in that combines rotating QR codes with GPS geofencing. Encouragement Prize at WebDev Adventure 2026.

projects.title: Diabetes Q&A Assistant
projects.description: A retrieval-augmented question answering system that grounds every answer in crawled medical sources, running a local LLM so sensitive questions never leave the machine.

projects.title: RL Dynamic Pricing
projects.description: A pricing engine that models an online store as a Markov decision process and learns prices that balance short-term profit with long-term customer retention.

projects.title: Chuck King
projects.description: A vertical rage platformer with a hand-written physics engine and an AI narrator that taunts you based on how often you fall.
